items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: So he's going to lead the band. He was supposed to play bass drum, but we couldn't get no trumpet player. So he played trumpet.

ctx.x: Call him. Yes. Things were so bad, he couldn't get musicians. Mm-hmm. And he was playing a few more way up in the night down a little bit. And I said, who's going to eat the bass? I said, how you call him? Harrison.
